skills.name: Spirit Flame
skills.description: Uses power of Spirit Flame. Good effects on surrounding allies.  *ATK Speed +180% (10 sec) *Hit Rate +30%  (10 sec) *HP x 30% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec)

skills.name: Faint Curse
skills.description: Throws out a cursed doll and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Use Rate -60% (7 sec) *ATK per sec x 400% Area Damage (7 sec)

abilities.name: Stone Cold
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't be turned against their allies  in stages with the Siren Song obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Skill Barrier
abilities.description: Continuously provides a barrier that protects against Skill Damage. - The Skill Barrier disappears after blocking Skill Damage 1 time and is reapplied 3 seconds later. - The Skill Barrier remains intact when Skill Damage is reduced to 0 through invincibility. - Boss, Guardian, and Special Type enemies' Skill Damage cannot be blocked.
